principle_violations.reason: The Order class handles responsibilities related to order management as well as payment processing. This violates the Single Responsibility Principle, as payment processing logic is inside the Order class.
principle_violations.suggestion: The payment processing logic should be delegated to a separate class, such as PaymentProcessor, to adhere to SRP.

principle_violations.reason: The pay method must be modified each time a new payment type is added, violating the Open/Closed Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a base class or interface for payment handling and extend for new payment types, rather than modifying the existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
